messages:
elyse: Quick flag: console YAML import example uses seconds for latency buckets; UI expects ms so p99 looks off. anyone seen this?

sam: yep that was the bug. docs example was seconds. UI treats numbers as ms.

jordan: add note about trace sampling affecting p99 too.

maria: plan: update YAML to ms, add sampling callout, include before/after screenshot.

elyse: opening PR with corrected snippet and screenshot, tagging reviewers.

sam: suggested snippet: 
```yaml
# latency histogram buckets (units = milliseconds)
latency_histogram_buckets: [1,5,10,25,50,75,100,250,500,1000,2500,5000]
```

jordan: wording for sampling: "If upstream trace sampling is enabled, tail percentiles (p99/p999) may be biased low; consider sampling-aware rollups or aggregated logs."

docs-bot: PR checklist: screenshots, cross-links, `make docs-preview`.

elyse: PR drafted (#7539). deploy-bot: staging import URL please.

deploy-bot: staging import at https://staging.console.internal/imports/7539-preview.

maria: I'll QA in staging and leave notes. merge on weekday if clean.

elyse: thanks everyone; targeting merge tomorrow EOD.

sam: nice catch!"
